source_rule_scope: Rules may group sources and document only local-copy or monitoring work that is actually planned. A source does not need a custom retrieval or conversion rule to be used as a human-reviewed official reference under the shared source selection policy.
source_version_policy: For every source class, use the responsible official publisher. Prefer a usable government-published consolidation for national legislation and the responsible EU publisher consolidation for EU legislation. Accept a government consolidation as a usable official reference when the publisher, instrument, and consolidation status are clear and no concrete warning undermines reliance. If trust is unclear, offer the whole official legal-text website/service, its authority/versioning information, and the relevant text to the user for human review. Otherwise use the closest government-published or official-service version and record its language, date/cutoff, and limitations. Consult individual Gazette acts only for a material issue; full amendment-chain reconstruction or full-site crawling is not a default requirement.
automation_default: A human-reviewed official reference is enough for ordinary research. Add local capture, conversion, replay, API access, or scheduled updating only when retaining a copy, reproducibility, or recurring monitoring is needed and permitted.
acceptance_policy: A human-reviewed official link may support research within its reviewed scope without a local copy. A government consolidation may be accepted as a usable official reference when its publisher, instrument, and status are clear; if trust is uncertain, offer the complete official site/service context to the user for human review. Local-copy checks are separate and proportionate to the artifact and intended reuse. Neither source acceptance nor a local hash establishes topic coverage or country completion.

retrieval.change_signal: not needed for ordinary human use; add only for recurring maintenance

reference_review.note: Record only what is displayed and what was reviewed; use a stated date/cutoff or note that none is shown.

validation: Check only content relied upon; use broader comparison when conversion is lossy or the whole converted text is relied upon.
Check attachments only when they affect the research.

rules.sustainability: <source limitations; add updater cadence/failure handling only if automated>
